SIDEBAR_DESCRIPTION.DIALOGFLOW: Dialogflow is a natural language processing platform for building conversational interfaces. Integrating it with {installationName} lets bots handle queries first and transfer them to agents when needed. It helps qualify leads and reduce agent workload by answering FAQs. OPENJARVIS.DESCRIPTION: Grant OpenJarvis controlled access to selected inboxes and AceleraChat operations.

FORM.TITLE: Access policy
FORM.ENABLED_HELP: Revoking access immediately invalidates API calls and stops webhook delivery.
FORM.ENDPOINT_HELP: Exact HTTPS URL that will receive signed AceleraChat events.
FORM.SERVICE_USER_HELP: Permissions and strict team visibility are evaluated as this user.
FORM.VALIDATION: Select a service user, at least one inbox and one API scope. The webhook must use HTTPS and cannot contain credentials, query parameters or fragments.

CREDENTIALS.TITLE: Credentials
CREDENTIALS.ONE_TIME: Copy these credentials now. Full values are only shown after creation or rotation.
CREDENTIALS.ROTATE_DESCRIPTION: The previous credential remains valid for 24 hours. Copy the new value and update OpenJarvis within that overlap.
CREDENTIALS.DISCONNECT_HELP: Disconnecting disables the API, stops webhooks and immediately revokes both credentials.
CREDENTIALS.DISCONNECT_DESCRIPTION: OpenJarvis will lose access immediately. Reconnecting requires generating and installing new credentials.
